sentences.japanese: なぜみんなが私のことを気違いだと思うのか、遂に説明してくれてありがとう。
sentences.english: Thanks for having explained to me at last why people take me for an idiot.

sentences.japanese: 彼はその仕事をやり遂げる力がある。
sentences.english: He is equal to the task.

sentences.japanese: 近年、化学は驚くべき進歩を遂げてきた。
sentences.english: Chemistry has made notable progress in recent years.

sentences.japanese: 出だしがよければ半ばやり遂げたようなものだ。
我々は援助しなかったので彼は自力でやり遂げた。
sentences.english: We didn't help him, so he did it off his own bat.
